source_en: Coming back from the corner shop. My mum needed bread.
I was playing outside with Dima. He went home so I came back.
I went to check if the school gates were open yet.
Coming inside because of the ash outside.
My mum sent me to get something from our neighbor in Block A.
Going home to Mum. She keeps trying to phone Dad in Varka.
Going back to the flat to wait for Mum. Block C, fourth floor.
Returning to the only place I still know.
Just coming home. I don't have anywhere else to go.
Going to school. Lessons start at eight.
Going home to my dad. He's making dinner tonight.
Coming back from my shift at the factory.
Going home to Block A. I live there with my grandma.
Going to the cinema with my dad.
Going home alone. I don't have any family here.
Going to school. My teacher says exams are tomorrow.
Dad and I are going home. Mum is away in Varka for work.
Going for a walk. Nothing out there scares me.
Sorry, I have the form somewhere, I swear I had it.
It is a lot quieter outside than it used to be.
I keep telling myself it's going to be fine. Is it going to be fine?
I didn't sleep much. I don't think anyone did.
My hands keep shaking and I can't tell if it's the cold or something else.
Mum tried to phone Dad in Varka again. The line just clicks.
I stopped checking the news. It wasn't helping.
Do you think it matters anymore? Coming through here, I mean.
I just want to go somewhere quiet and sit for a while.
Thank you. Sorry for the wait.
Okay. Thanks. Try to stay safe out here.
Right. Okay. I'll... yeah. Thank you.
What? No, I didn't do anything wrong!
Please, I just want to go back to my mum.
I knew something like this was going to happen. I always knew.
Wait... I don't want... I wasn't ready...
Please... I still had things... I still had things to do...
I knew... I always knew... it was going to end like this...
I... okay. Okay. It’s okay. I just need a minute. Give me a minute.
I’m not infected. I’ve been so careful. I’ve been so incredibly careful.
Please don’t tell my parents. They’ll just worry more. Please.
But I hadn’t... I was supposed to... I still had things... I still had things...
I wasn’t ready… I wasn’t even close to ready…
I want my mom… I just… I want my mom…
Where are you coming from?
The corner shop. Mum needed bread. I had the coupons in my pocket the whole time, I checked.
Block A. Mum sent me to our neighbour for matches. The ash started falling so I ran back.
Just outside, around the blocks. Mum isn't back yet and the flat is too quiet.
From school. Lessons finished early today, so the teacher let us go.
From home, in Block F. We live on the second floor, next to the stairs.
From the station. I went to meet my dad. He came home from Varka yesterday.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
My hands shake sometimes. Mum says it's the cold. I don't have a fever, I checked twice.
I can't sleep much. And I had a nosebleed. Only one. Is that bad? Sorry.
My tummy hurts a lot. Maybe because there isn't much food. I'm fine. Mostly.
No. My hands are totally still, look. I never get nervous about anything.
No. I sleep really well. Mum and Dad tuck me in every night.
I'm fine. The school nurse checked me this morning before lessons.
Sorry, is this the right form? I filled it out twice just in case.
It is a lot quieter outside lately. Did you notice that from here?
My hands keep shaking. It is probably just the cold.
Have you heard anything about Varka? My dad is there for work.
I am not sleeping well. I think it shows. Sorry.
Is the process taking longer than usual today? I do not mind, I am just... checking.
Do you think it still matters? Coming through here. I keep doing it anyway.
I stopped checking the news. It was not helping.
Is there somewhere safer than this? Just... anywhere. I am asking everyone.
